faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything owners usually want to know before we start.

one.q: How much does the management service cost?
one.a: We work on a commission basis — a percentage of the rental income we actually generate for you. No upfront fees and no flat monthly charges: if you don't earn, neither do we.

two.q: How and when do I receive my income?
two.a: Once a month, straight to your bank account, together with a clear statement of bookings, income and expenses. You can track everything without ever visiting Bansko.

three.q: Can I still use the property myself?
three.a: Of course — it stays your home. Block dates in the calendar for yourself, family or friends whenever you like, and we plan bookings around them.

four.q: What happens if a guest damages something?
four.a: We collect security deposits, document the condition after every stay and handle the whole process — from claiming the deposit to arranging repairs with our own team.

five.q: Which properties and areas do you work with?
five.a: Apartments, studios and houses across Bansko, Razlog and Banya village. After a short viewing we'll tell you honestly what income your property can realistically achieve.

six.a: Typically under 30 days from the first call: viewing and income estimate, professional photos, pricing and listings on all major platforms — then the first guests.
